Stromma Netherlands carries the brands 'Canal Tours Amsterdam', 'Canal Tours Utrecht' and Amsterdam Excursions, with distribution channel Stromma.com. Stromma Netherlands is part of the Swedish Stromma Group (Strömma Turism & Sjöfart). Host of Amsterdam 
As the host of Amsterdam, we are committed to providing unforgettable experiences to our guests in Amsterdam and Utrecht with a team of enthusiastic employees. We always strive to give every single guest memories for life . Our fleet has something to offer for every occasion. A relaxed cruise on a classic canal boat, exploring the unknown canals by electric sloop, discovering the canal belt at your own pace by pedal boat, a canal transfer to combine transport with sightseeing or dining and drinks on board - at Stromma anything is possible. 
 About Stromma Group 
Stromma Group is the leading provider of experiences within sightseeing in Northern Europe. These experiences focus on sightseeing tours, entertainment and activities for tourists, local residents and companies. Stromma has a history dating back to 1809 with a strong tradition of historic and cultural values. Today Stromma operates in 18 destinations in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands. Sustainability at Stromma 
Stromma focuses with its new strategy on sustainable tourism. Our vision is therefore: Northern Europe's leading sustainable producer and provider of tours and activities. Stromma Netherlands has been rewarded with the Green Key certificate. The burden on the environment is further limited by the increasing use of electricity to replace the current natural gas and hybrid diesel-electric engines. Read more about sustainability at Stromma. 
 You have now signed up for Stromma newsletter. 
 Stromma Netherlands
